text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Win, win, win...! The one who wins is—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's meeeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(This intensity... this heat! It feels 
like it's carving deep, deep into me——)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
――In 1st place is Vodka! She has 
brilliantly seized the crown!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I-I-I... d-did it! I did it, I really did 
it...! I took Chan—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I am Vodka!
(Waaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
A-Amazing, amazing, amazing! Did you see 
that? Such a dynamic run! So cool~~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"To think she actually won...! I wonder 
what race she'll run next!?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"At the very least, she's gonna be a 
headliner next year! Man... that was 
amazing!"

Vodka raises her fist and roars. Behind 
her, countless feverish eyes were fixed 
upon her back.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...... Well now, not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Nngh, so annoying!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Even I...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...She completely got the better of me. 
Vodka..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Change of plans.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Regarding our next race... In Chan's 
opinion, I was thinking we take the royal 
road to the Oka Sho with the Tulip Sho.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Still, the stone Vodka cast made a massive 
splash. The ripples must have reached 
Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Causality turns like a spinning wheel.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Then, just maybe, perhaps... ...Vodka 
too."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, who do you think will win 
between Scarlet and Vodka?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It's the Tulip Sho.
choice_data_list:
...Did they say both of them would be 
running?

...Did they say both of them would be 
entering the race?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No, not quite yet. Vodka is still at the 
stage of deciding whether to aim for the 
Classic Triple Crown or the Triple Tiara 
route.
choice_data_list: Then running in the Tulip Sho means—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Generally speaking, the Tulip Sho is a 
race where many Umamusume aiming to run in 
the Oka Sho tend to compete.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It is not yet certain we will appear. 
However, I shall make it so. And then, the 
two of us shall send high pillars of flame 
into the sky.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's a pillar of fire that Chan couldn't 
raise alone. Vivid and dramatic. Everyone 
will look up at it in awe.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"And that is when Mar-chan makes her 
long-awaited entrance. This is truly the 
grandest stage in full bloom."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, let's make the Fillies' 
Revue your next race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even more than usual, I had no idea what 
she was talking about... but in her mind, 
it seemed to be a done deal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan had always had a habit of 
tuning out other people's opinions, for 
better or worse.
choice_data_list:
(Even if I opposed it, she wouldn't listen 
anyway.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the Fillies' Revue is considered 
a trial race for the Oka Sho. It's 
certainly not a bad choice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The next race is the Fillies' Revue. I 
made that decision while praying for the 
day she might share her true feelings with 
me."
